想看红杉，又不确定自己能走多久，可以先把第一次安排成短程往返。Reinhardt: If you want to see redwoods but aren't sure how far you can walk, make your first visit a short out-and-back. Reinhardt Redwood sits in the Oakland hills and has several entrances and many connecting trails. Entering the same park doesn't mean taking the same route. This guide focuses on getting started near Canyon Meadow: know your way in and back, then explore farther next time.
先读维修公告，再保存路线: Read repair notices before saving your route
本次核验时，EBRPD 公园页列有 Stream Trail 分段维修：涉及 T: At the time of review, EBRPD's park page listed repairs along sections of Stream Trail between Trail's End and Fern Trail, with additional work near Old Church. Older loop routes online should not be assumed fully open. Check the notices at the top of the page on your departure day. If even your short section is affected, choose another date; do not go around barriers or seek an alternative along the creek bank.
集合写 Canyon Meadow，不只写 Redwood: Specify Canyon Meadow as the meeting point, not just Redwood
这份安排从 Redwood Road 上的 Redwood Gate 进入，再到: This plan enters through Redwood Gate on Redwood Road, then continues to Canyon Meadow Staging Area. Don't confuse it with Skyline Gate on the ridge. Use the EBRPD map to connect the vehicle entrance, parking, and trailhead. When fees apply, the current park page specifies cash; check again before leaving, along with seasonal parking-gate hours.
第一次只做能原路返回的小行程: For your first visit, choose a short route you can retrace
路线为 Redwood Gate 进入、Canyon Meadow 集合、Str: Enter through Redwood Gate, meet at Canyon Meadow, take a short out-and-back on the part of Stream Trail open that day, and return to Canyon Meadow. Official information places a children's play area a short way along Stream Trail from the start. It can be a short-trip goal; don't continue into construction areas, and don't assume any particular segment will be open that day.
所有人到齐再离开停车点，拍下入口名称与公告牌。: Wait until everyone arrives before leaving the parking area. Photograph the entrance name and notice board.
确认当前通行方向与折返点；不要因手机导航画出线就越过封闭标识。: Confirm the current travel direction and turnaround point. A line on your phone's map does not authorize crossing a closure sign.
开放短段慢走后回头: Take a short walk on an open section, then turn back
以近处游乐设施一带或更早位置为目标，留意林下环境，不沿溪岸离开正式步道。: Aim for the area around the nearby play facilities or an earlier turnaround. Notice the forest surroundings and stay on established paths rather than following the creek bank.
清点同行者，在原集合点休息、整理装备，再离园。: Check that everyone is together, rest and organize your gear at the original meeting point, then leave the park.
少看一点手机，多认识一点森林: Spend less time on your phone and more time getting to know the forest
公园官方介绍说明，这片红杉林经历过历史采伐与再生，不宜一概写成未受扰动的原始林。: The park's official history describes logging and regrowth, so this redwood forest should not simply be called untouched old growth. On a first visit, notice how the canopy frames the sky and light reaches the forest floor, then read an interpretive sign. There is no need to climb trees, peel bark, or step into vegetation for photos. Watch animals from the trail without chasing or feeding them.
官方地图把 Redwood Creek 一带划作资源保护区域：人和狗都应离开溪流: The official map identifies the Redwood Creek area as a resource protection zone. People and dogs must stay out of the creek and off its banks; dogs must be leashed on Stream Trail and Bridle Trail. The creek is not a place for children to wade or dogs to cool off. Rest in designated open areas rather than treating the creek bank as a quieter picnic spot.
装备按“信号弱也能回去”准备: Pack so you can get back even with weak cell service
下载 EBRPD 地图到手机，保存入口与停车点；公园说明手机信号很弱或没有。: Download the EBRPD map and save the entrance and parking location. The park notes that cell service is weak or unavailable.
带足饮水、少量食物、防滑鞋与外层衣物，不把路上补水当作必然可用。: Bring enough water, a little food, shoes with traction, and an outer layer. Don't count on drinking water being available along the way.
把出发入口、同行人数和预计返回时间告诉未同行的人，约好超时怎样联系。: Tell someone who isn't coming your entrance, group size, and expected return time, and agree on how to follow up if you're late.
推车或使用轮椅时核对所需路段的坡度、路面与维修；停车区可达不等于整条步道无障碍。: For a stroller or wheelchair, check slopes, surfaces, and maintenance on the specific route. An accessible parking area does not mean the whole trail is accessible.
从 EBRPD Safety 页查天气和火险，遇高温、强风或关闭通知就缩短或取消: Check weather and fire conditions on EBRPD's Safety page. Shorten or cancel the outing in heat, strong winds, or closures.
把折返当成计划的一部分: Make turning back part of the plan
别等到最慢的同行者已经累了才商量返程。到第一个约定位置就问是否继续，任何人想回头: Don't wait until the slowest person is exhausted to discuss heading back. At the first agreed stop, ask whether everyone wants to continue. If anyone wants to turn back, return together along the same route. If you're being picked up, agree on how the driver will wait in advance rather than trying to arrange a ride from a parking area with weak signal. A comfortable short walk is a better start than struggling through an unfamiliar loop.
找同样愿意慢走的森林同行者: Find a forest-walk companion who likes a slower pace
写清 Canyon Meadow、短程往返、查看当天封闭通知，以及是否带孩子或狗: Specify Canyon Meadow, a short out-and-back, a check of that day's closures, and whether children or dogs are coming. Don't assume everyone can manage a long route.
